coordinateSystem: top-left origin, x right, y down, source pixel units
footNaming: view-relative: A=near, B=far; not anatomical left/right

travelTest.note: Nominal visualization speed; root must calibrate against observed stance foot displacement. Not runtime movement acceptance.

limitations: Six discrete painted walk poses; no dense in-between animation or runtime integration.
groundLineNote: Historical measurements from withdrawn three-quarter-view drafts only; not accepted contact targets or two physical floor heights. A new side-profile cycle must be measured again and must not reuse these draft ground lines. No per-frame registration.
